title: Lock the core API runtimes and remove obsolete SSE/Pydantic/dependency branches
summary: Locked the core API and service runtimes against official PyPI latest stable releases under Python 3.12. Established root constraints at dependencies/constraints-core.txt and generated all 28 service and root-test lockfiles under dependencies/locks/. Removed obsolete Pydantic v1 compatibility branches (.dict(), __fields__, v1 dump/copy/validate/json wrappers) across consultation and openclaw-gateway-adapter services while preserving generic dict/dataclass handling and idempotency hash serialization. Replaced custom handwritten SSE framing, heartbeat, and header logic with FastAPI-native SSE (EventSourceResponse, format_sse_event) in control-plane BFF events and openclaw-gateway-adapter. Cleaned runtime dependencies: removed python-jose, passlib, and pytest from BFF requirements, added explicit cryptography>=50.0.1, and removed pytest from openclaw-gateway-adapter requirements. Reconciled services/search/Dockerfile to install from existing services/search/requirements.lock without creating competing second locks; pinned integrations/openclaw/gateway/Dockerfile, Dockerfile.smoke, and services/registry/Dockerfile.test against the core baseline. Verified with 299 passed tests across consultation, openclaw-gateway-adapter, SSE contracts, and auth suites with zero missing-dependency skips.

candidate_4_disposition.description: Native SSE and one Pydantic-v2 API baseline

pydantic_v1_removals.details: Removed fallback branches to .dict() and model_dump(mode='json') wrapping; replaced with native Pydantic v2 model_dump(mode='json'), model_dump_json(), and model_copy(deep=True). Preserved generic dict/dataclass serialization.
Removed .dict() calls in _actor_to_data and _request_dict. Replaced __fields__ traversal in _stored_create_fingerprint with model_fields iteration for Pydantic v2.
Removed hasattr(obj, 'dict') branch in _model_dict; standardized on model_dump(mode='json').

native_sse_migration.details: Migrated from custom SSE framing to fastapi.sse.EventSourceResponse and fastapi.sse.format_sse_event. Preserved tenant filtering, bounded queues, Last-Event-ID replay, 409 resync, disconnect cancellation, and [DONE] termination.
Migrated stream endpoint to fastapi.sse.EventSourceResponse and fastapi.sse.format_sse_event.
Migrated invoke_openclaw_provider_stream to fastapi.sse.EventSourceResponse and fastapi.sse.format_sse_event.

review_decision.note: Independently verify against this exact head: (1) dependencies/constraints-core.txt pins the core API runtime to official latest stable releases (fastapi==0.141.1, pydantic==2.13.5, uvicorn==0.53.0, etc.); (2) all 28 service lockfiles in dependencies/locks/ compiled cleanly against core constraints; (3) Pydantic v1 compatibility branches (.dict(), __fields__, v1 dump/copy/validate/json wrappers) removed from consultation and openclaw-gateway-adapter; (4) handwritten SSE framing replaced with fastapi.sse native EventSourceResponse/format_sse_event; (5) python-jose and passlib removed from bff/requirements.txt while cryptography>=50.0.1 is explicitly declared and auth tests pass; (6) services/search/Dockerfile reconciled with requirements.lock; (7) all 299 tests pass with zero dependency skips.
